title: OCR engines on scanned guitar books

config.reference: claude-opus-5 transcription per page; 'checked' once read by hand

metrics.label: CER
metrics.description: Edit distance over the reference length, whitespace removed.

metrics.label: Char recall
metrics.description: Share of the reference's characters the read found, order ignored.

metrics.label: Char precision
metrics.description: Share of the read's characters that are in the reference; notation read as text lowers it.

metrics.label: s / page
metrics.description: Wall time to read one page at 150 dpi, model load excluded.

metrics.label: $ / page
metrics.description: API spend per page; the local engines cost nothing.

findings: On the two Chinese books Tesseract fast finds 72–80% of the text; every PP-OCR model finds 97–99%.
PP-OCRv6 tiny is the pick: as accurate as anything here, the best precision, and 0.62 s/page — a 300-page scan drops from ~12 minutes to ~3. Larger models buy a point of recall for 4–20× the time.
English is not a clean win: on the 3-page rock excerpt PP-OCR finds 88% to Tesseract's 96%; on the 6-page one they tie.
Tesseract crashed its process on one page (arranging p09, a segfault in get_textpage_ocr). The scan runs OCR in-process, so that page would take book-service down.
tessdata_best is again slower and no better (~50 s/page with chi_sim_vert).
References are Opus 5 transcriptions (Sonnet 5 a second reading, $1.44), not yet checked by hand. Calibration §11.
findings_zh: 两本中文书上，Tesseract fast 只读到 72–80% 的字；PP-OCR 各个尺寸都在 97–99%。
PP-OCRv6 tiny 最合适：准确度和最好的持平、精确率最高、每页 0.62 秒——300 页的扫描从约 12 分钟降到约 3 分钟。更大的模型多一个点召回，要多花 4–20 倍时间。
英文不是全胜：3 页那本英文书上 PP-OCR 召回 88%、Tesseract 96%（那几页有倒印的文字）；6 页那本两者持平。
Tesseract 在编曲 p09 上把整个进程弄崩了（get_textpage_ocr 里的段错误）。扫描是在服务进程里跑 OCR 的，遇到这一页整个 book-service 会挂掉。
tessdata_best 又一次更慢且不更准（带上竖排模型后每页约 50 秒）。
标准答案是 Opus 5 转写的（Sonnet 5 第二遍，共 $1.44），还没人工核对。详见 calibration §11。
